info.title: GainTrace API
info.description:
The GainTrace REST API (v1). Read your customer data and push product-usage events, metric events, and signals into GainTrace.

All endpoints are authenticated with a Bearer API key and scoped to a single workspace.

get.description:
Returns the workspace's companies, most-recently-updated first.

**Scope:** `read:companies`

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on name or domain.

post.description:
Creates a company, or updates the existing one with the same `externalId` (upsert).

**Scope:** `write:companies`

get.description:
Returns non-dismissed signals for the workspace, most-recent first.

**Scope:** `read:signals`

post.description:
Records a signal against a company in the workspace.

**Scope:** `write:signals`

Ingests a batch of product-usage events (Segment-style). Feeds health, signals, and activation recompute.

Accepts server keys (`gt_live_`, scope `write:events`) or client-safe browser keys (`gt_pub_`, scope `write:ingest`). Public ingest is CORS-enabled.

**Scope:** `write:events` or `write:ingest` · **Max 1000 events per request.**

Ingests a batch of typed metric events into the metrics engine (feeds daily snapshots that calc metrics evaluate). Idempotent on `(source, externalId)`; duplicates are skipped silently. Returns a per-event outcome.

**Scope:** `write:events` · **1–500 events per request.**

202.description: Batch processed. See `outcomes` for per-event status.

get.description:
Fetch one company by UUID or `ext:<externalId>`.

**Scope:** `read:companies`

patch.description:
Update mutable fields on an existing company.

**Scope:** `write:companies`

Update a signal's title, description, severity, snooze, or metadata.

**Scope:** `write:signals`

post.description:
Create up to 1000 signals. Partial success: each item reports its own outcome.

**Scope:** `write:signals`

get.description:
List contacts, optionally scoped to one account or email.

**Scope:** `read:contacts`

post.description:
Create a contact under an account. Email is unique per workspace (409 on conflict).

**Scope:** `write:contacts`

Register a webhook subscription. The signing `secret` is returned only in this response.

**Scope:** `write:webhooks`

patch.description:
Update url, events, headers, description, or active state.

**Scope:** `write:webhooks`

delete.description:
Delete a webhook and its delivery history.

**Scope:** `write:webhooks`

post.description:
Send a signed `ping` to the endpoint now and return the result.

**Scope:** `write:webhooks`

bearerAuth.description: Bearer API key. Secret server keys start with `gt_live_`; client-safe browser keys start with `gt_pub_` (write-only, origin-pinned). Create and scope keys in Settings → API Keys.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Max rows to return. Default 50, max 100.

pathId.name: id
pathId.description: Resource UUID. For companies you may also pass `ext:<externalId>` to address by your external id.

BadRequest.description: The request could not be parsed (for example, malformed JSON).

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked API key.

PaymentRequired.description: A plan limit was reached, or billing is locked. Upgrade or enable pay-as-you-go.

error.message: Monthly event limit reached. Upgrade or enable overage billing.

Forbidden.description: The key is valid but lacks the required scope, the origin is not allowed, or API v1 is not enabled for the workspace.

NotFound.description: The resource, or a resource you referenced, was not found in this workspace.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with an existing resource (for example, a duplicate email).

error.message: A contact with this email already exists in the workspace

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request was well-formed but a value failed validation.

error.message: Request validation failed. name: name is required

RateLimited.description: The per-key rate limit was exceeded. Back off and retry.

error.message: Rate limit exceeded. Maximum 120 requests per minute per API key.

InternalServerError.description: An unexpected error occurred on our side. The failure is logged; retry shortly.

error.message: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A backing service (for example, the database) was temporarily unavailable. Retry shortly.

error.message: We had trouble reaching the database. Try again in a moment.

GatewayTimeout.description: The request took too long upstream before completing. Retry, and reduce batch size for large payloads.

error.message: The request timed out. Try again in a moment.

count.description: Number of rows in this page.

Error.description: The standard error envelope. Every 4xx/5xx response uses this shape.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable error code. Each code maps to exactly one HTTP status.

message.description: Human-readable, safe description of what went wrong. Never contains internal or provider detail.

doc_url.description: Deep link to this code in the Errors reference.

Company.description: A canonical company record. Health, counts, and timestamps are read-only.

externalId.description: Your stable external id (unique per workspace). Used for upsert.

arr.description: Annual recurring revenue in integer minor units of `currency`.

mrr.description: Monthly recurring revenue in integer minor units of `currency`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Null = workspace reporting currency.

index.description: Index of the offending event in the batch.

strict.description: When true, reject events whose `eventName` is not registered in event definitions.

MetricEvent.description: Provide exactly one company key (`companyId` OR `companyExternalId`). Contact attribution is optional.

companyExternalId.description: Account slug/CRM id; resolves to a company. Provide this or `companyId`.

properties.description: Optionally shape-validated against the event definition.

externalId.description: Idempotency key; repeats are skipped silently.

CompanyUpsert.description: Create or update a company. Upserts on `externalId` (defaults to a slug of `name`).

externalId.description: Upsert key. Defaults to a slug of the name.

CompanyPatch.description: Any subset of the writable company fields. `healthScore`/`healthStatus`/counts are read-only.

SignalPatch.description: Any subset of the mutable signal fields.

snoozedUntil.description: Snooze until this time, or null to unsnooze.

accountId.description: The golden account this contact belongs to.

externalId.description: Your stable user id (for event resolution).

accountId.description: Golden account UUID; must belong to your workspace.

ContactPatch.description: Any subset of the mutable contact fields.

headers.description: Custom headers sent with each delivery. Values are redacted (`***`) in responses.

secretPrefix.description: First chars of the signing secret. Full secret is returned only at creation.

disabledAt.description: Set when auto-disabled after sustained failures.

url.description: HTTPS only; may not resolve to a private/reserved address.

headers.description: Optional custom headers (e.g. an auth token). Reserved/signing headers are rejected. Max 20, 4KB total.

WebhookPatch.description: Any subset. Setting `active:true` also clears the auto-disable failure state.

secret.description: The signing secret, returned ONCE. Store it now.

SignalListItem.description: Subset returned by the list endpoint. GET /signals/{id} returns the full Signal.
